subject: Next steps: Marketplace procurement & payment path for LumenAI
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@lumenai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up + next steps from today's demo (procurement & marketplace)

Jared — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and a few asks so we can move the procurement path forward:

- Key win criteria you mentioned: predictable per-token costs, dedicated capacity for production inference, and marketplace billing if possible.
- Marketplace: you said LumenAI prefers to purchase via AWS Marketplace when possible. Would procurement want us listed as a SaaS subscription or a metered usage listing?
- Payment method: is purchasing via PO (net 30) required, or can you use corporate card for initial pilots?
- Vendor onboarding: please share procurement/security contacts so we can start vendor registration.

Attachments: I attached our latest pricing sheet (redwood-pricing-sheet.pdf) and a short one-pager on marketplace billing flows.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm procurement path (PO vs card) + Marketplace listing type.
2) If PO, please share preferred PO template and contact.
3) If Marketplace, let us know which account (AWS account ID or AWS Marketplace Buyer ID) we should route billing to and whether you need a private offers flow.

Happy to hop on a quick call with procurement if that speeds things up — looping Marissa from our procurement ops.

Thanks,

Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment: redwood-pricing-sheet.pdf

From: Jared Cole <jared.cole@lumenai.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@lumenai.com
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up + next steps from today's demo (procurement & marketplace)

Camila — great demo, thanks. Quick answers from procurement side:

- Payment: LumenAI prefers PO (net 45) for any production/contracted spend. We can use corporate card for initial POC up to $5k, but prefer PO for anything longer.
- Marketplace: we try to procure via AWS Marketplace when possible. For Redwood, we would prefer a private offer (metered usage) that bills to our AWS account.
- Vendor onboarding: CC'd procurement mailbox (procurement@lumenai.com) — they will send vendor registration forms. They typically need SOC 2 info + bank/W9.

I've attached our procurement questionnaire — procurement team will fill and return (lumenai-procurement-questionnaire.xlsx).

Questions for you: can Redwood provide a private offer through AWS Marketplace with metered billing? And what is typical lead time for onboarding (vendor registration + private offer setup)?

Thanks,
Jared
Head of ML Platforms | LumenAI
jared.cole@lumenai.com

Attachment: lumenai-procurement-questionnaire.xlsx

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@lumenai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, procurement@lumenai.com
Date: Sun, 01 Mar 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up + next steps from today's demo (procurement & marketplace)

Thanks Jared — great, appreciate the clarity. Short answers below and proposed next steps:

- Private offer (metered) on AWS Marketplace: yes, Redwood supports AWS Marketplace private offers and metered usage listings. We can configure billing to your AWS account and offer a private offer with negotiated pricing or committed usage if you prefer.
- Lead time: vendor registration and private offer provisioning typically take 2-3 weeks once we have procurement questionnaire + SOC 2 details. If you already have an AWS Marketplace buyer account and can share the account ID, that speeds things up.
- PO flow: we accept PO/net terms. For contract paperwork (SOW or Master Subscription Agreement) we can route through DocuSign once PO details are provided.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Procurement team (procurement@lumenai.com) to return the completed questionnaire and attach your preferred PO template.
2) If you want a private offer, please share the AWS account ID and desired billing cadence.
3) I'll kick off vendor onboarding and loop our partner ops to start the Marketplace listing process.

I've attached a short SOW template for procurement review and put Marissa on copy to coordinate contract/legal approvals.

Let me know if you want a 30-min kickoff with our partner ops and procurement to walk through the timeline — happy to schedule this week.

Best,

Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment: redwood-sow-template.docx
